notes: These are directly reported composite SAT 25th and 75th percentiles. Component percentiles were not added. They describe score submitters among enrolled first-years, not all applicants or all admitted students, not admission cutoffs, not program-specific minimums, and not Ontario grade equivalents.

Penn State official CDS landing page https://opair.psu.edu/institutional-research/projects/cds/ identifies the University Park 2025–2026 report. Verified C9 in official PDF text, with Fall 2025 cohort defined by section C1/C9.

Ohio State official PDF contains the reported numeric table as rendered graphics; web text extraction omits numbers. The original official PDF was downloaded and page 19 rendered and visually inspected: composite 1300 / 1380 / 1440; SAT submitters 25.00%, 2099; Fall 2025 cohort.

Wisconsin official CDS page https://data.wisc.edu/common-data-set-and-rankings/ returned 403 to browsing, but the university-hosted public Box XLSX downloaded successfully. CDS-A identifies UW–Madison and the official CDS page; CDS-C rows 160–179 directly report Fall 2025, composite 1400 / 1450 / 1490, 11.8%, and 1000 SAT submitters. The Box URL is the actual inspected primary source.

NYU omitted from ranges: the official latest PDF https://www.nyu.edu/content/dam/nyu/institutionalResearch/documents/cds-2025-2026/CDS%202025-2026%20FINAL%20%28no%20G%29.pdf and official institutional research page returned 405/403. Secondary sites consistently report 1480–1550 for Fall 2025, but this task requires direct official-source verification; that range has not been imported. Do not label it verified from this file.
